# `introspect` command

Output machine-readable JSON describing the project structure.

```bash
fobis introspect [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Building](/cookbook/build), [CI and machine output](/cookbook/ci).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Specify a "fobos" file named differently from "fobos" |
| `--fci` |  |  | Assume fobos inputs as case insensitive |
| `--mode` | TEXT |  | Select a mode defined into a fobos file |
| `--shadow` | TEXT |  | Rebuild the mode as a shadow (checks, sanitize or strict): the mode's settings with checking flags, in its own build directory (.fobis/shadow/&lt;mode&gt;-&lt;shadow&gt;/). |
| `--sources` |  |  | Show source files |
| `--compiler` |  |  | Show compiler info |
| `--dependencies` |  |  | Show declared dependencies |
| `--targets` |  |  | Show build targets |
| `--include-dirs` |  |  | Show include directories |
| `--buildoptions` |  |  | Show all fobos mode options |
| `--projectinfo` |  |  | Show [project] section metadata |
| `--varsets` |  |  | Show available [varset:NAME] sections and their bindings |
| `--all` |  |  | Show all introspection data |
| `--compile-commands` |  |  | Print the compilation database of the mode's build (what fobis build writes in compile_commands.json) and compile nothing; not combinable with the other sections |
| `--write` |  |  | Write individual intro-*.json files into .fobis-info/ |
| `--format` | TEXT | `json` | Output format: json (default) or toml |
| `--varset` | TEXT |  | Apply one or more [varset:NAME] sections' $variable bindings (comma- or space-separated; last write wins) before resolving introspection data. |

<!-- cli:end -->
